sets.title: Aspect in Narratives
sets.description: Choose the correct aspect for each narrative context
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильный вид глагола для каждого контекста

items.prompt: На улице _____ снег. Было тихо. (Snow was falling outside. It was quiet.)
items.promptEnglish: Snow was falling outside. It was quiet.
items.explanation: Background description uses imperfective: шёл (was falling). This sets the scene.

items.prompt: Она _____ дверь и вошла в комнату. (She opened the door and entered the room.)
items.promptEnglish: She opened the door and entered the room.
items.explanation: Sequence of events: opened (completed), entered. Both perfective: открыла.

items.prompt: В детстве каждое утро бабушка _____ нам блины. (Every morning grandma made us pancakes.)
items.promptEnglish: In childhood, every morning grandma made us pancakes.
items.hint: Repeated past actions (каждое утро) use imperfective.
items.explanation: Habitual/repeated past action (каждое утро) requires imperfective: готовила.

items.prompt: Мы гуляли в парке, когда вдруг _____ гроза. (We were walking in the park when suddenly a storm started.)
items.promptEnglish: We were walking in the park when a storm suddenly started.
items.hint: A sudden interrupting event uses perfective.
items.explanation: A sudden interruption (вдруг) uses perfective: началась.

items.prompt: Пока отец _____ машину, мать собирала вещи. (While father was washing the car, mother was packing things.)
items.promptEnglish: While father was washing the car, mother was packing things.
items.hint: Simultaneous ongoing actions (пока) both use imperfective.
items.explanation: Simultaneous background actions with 'пока' use imperfective: мыл.

items.prompt: Он _____ чай, сел за стол и начал работать. (He made tea, sat down, and started working.)
items.promptEnglish: He made tea, sat down, and started working.
items.hint: A chain of completed actions uses perfective.
items.explanation: Sequential completed events: заварил, сел, начал. All perfective.

items.prompt: Она _____ весь день и очень устала. (She worked all day and was very tired.)
items.promptEnglish: She worked all day and was very tired.
items.explanation: Duration marker 'весь день' requires imperfective past: работала.

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ обед два часа. (He cooked dinner for two hours - duration.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He cooked dinner for two hours (focus on the process).
minimalPairs.explanation: Duration (два часа) emphasizes the process, requiring imperfective: готовил.

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ обед и позвал всех к столу. (He cooked dinner and called everyone to the table.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He finished cooking dinner and called everyone.
minimalPairs.explanation: Completed action followed by the next event requires perfective: приготовил.

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ задачу, но так и не решила. (She was solving the problem but never solved it.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She was working on the problem but didn't solve it.
minimalPairs.explanation: Process without result uses imperfective: решала. The 'но не решила' confirms no completion.

minimalPairs.context: Наконец она _____ эту задачу! (She finally solved this problem!)

sets.title: Fill and Fix
sets.description: Choose the right aspect form and fix aspect errors
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильную форму и исправьте ошибки в виде глагола

blanks: Мы _____ по улице, когда увидели старого друга. (We were walking down the street when we saw an old friend.)
Он _____ дверь, снял пальто и прошёл в комнату. (He opened the door, took off his coat, and walked into the room.)
Раньше она каждый вечер _____ книги. (She used to read books every evening.)
Вдруг кто-то _____ в дверь. (Suddenly someone knocked on the door.)
hints: Ongoing action interrupted by seeing someone. Which aspect for the background?
First in a chain of completed actions. Which aspect?
Habitual past action (каждый вечер). Which aspect?
explanations: Background action before interruption uses imperfective: шли (were walking).
First event in a completed sequence uses perfective: открыл.
Repeated habitual action uses imperfective: читала.
Sudden single event uses perfective: постучал.

errorCorrection.sentence: Дети играли в саду, когда начинался дождь.
errorCorrection.hint: The rain starting is a sudden single event that interrupts the playing.
errorCorrection.explanation: The interrupting event is a completed action: imperfective начинался should be perfective начался.

errorCorrection.sentence: Он вставал, умылся и вышел из дома.
errorCorrection.hint: All three actions in this sequence are completed events.
errorCorrection.explanation: Sequential completed actions all use perfective: встал (not imperfective вставал).
Телефон is masculine: позвонил (not позвонила). The perfective aspect is correct here.

errorCorrection.sentence: Каждый день он приготовил завтрак в семь часов.
errorCorrection.hint: Каждый день signals a repeated action. Which aspect for repetition?
errorCorrection.explanation: Repeated habitual actions (каждый день) require imperfective: готовил, not perfective приготовил.

items.prompt: Весь вечер мы _____ и смеялись. (All evening we talked and laughed.)
items.promptEnglish: All evening we talked and laughed.
items.explanation: Duration with simultaneous ongoing actions uses imperfective: разговаривали.

items.prompt: Она _____ письмо и отправила его. (She wrote the letter and sent it.)
items.promptEnglish: She wrote the letter and sent it.
items.hint: Completed action followed by the next step = perfective.
items.explanation: Sequential completed actions use perfective: написала, отправила.

items.prompt: В комнате было тихо. Все _____. (The room was quiet. Everyone was sleeping.)
items.promptEnglish: The room was quiet. Everyone was sleeping.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All narrative aspect patterns in one final round
sets.descriptionRussian: Все аспектные паттерны в одном финальном раунде

items.prompt: Было поздно. Город _____. (It was late. The city was sleeping.)
items.promptEnglish: It was late. The city was sleeping.
items.hint: A background state describing the scene.
items.explanation: Scene-setting background state uses imperfective: город спал.

items.prompt: Она _____ кошелёк и побежала в полицию. (She lost her wallet and ran to the police.)
items.promptEnglish: She lost her wallet and ran to the police.
items.hint: A completed event that triggers the next action.
items.explanation: Completed event in a sequence uses perfective: потеряла.

items.prompt: Раньше мы часто _____ в этом ресторане. (We used to eat at this restaurant often.)
items.promptEnglish: We used to eat at this restaurant often.
items.explanation: Habitual past with 'раньше' and 'часто' requires imperfective: обедали.

errorCorrection.sentence: Пока она приготовила ужин, дети смотрели мультфильм.
errorCorrection.hint: Пока (while) describes two simultaneous ongoing actions.
errorCorrection.explanation: With 'пока' both actions are simultaneous and ongoing, requiring imperfective: готовила, not perfective приготовила.

errorCorrection.hint: Вдруг signals a sudden action. Which aspect for sudden events?
errorCorrection.explanation: A sudden action (вдруг) requires perfective: встал, not imperfective вставал.

errorCorrection.hint: Долго emphasizes the duration of the process.
errorCorrection.explanation: Duration marker 'долго' requires imperfective: писала, not perfective написала.

translation.english: While she was cooking, the children were playing.
translation.hint: пока = while, готовила = was cooking (impf), играли = were playing (impf)

translation.english: He read the book and fell asleep.
translation.hint: Sequential completed actions: прочитал (finished reading), заснул (fell asleep)

translation.english: I was watching a movie when my friend called.
translation.answer: Я смотрел фильм, когда позвонил друг.
acceptableVariants: Я смотрела фильм, когда позвонил друг.
Я смотрел фильм, когда друг позвонил.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these past tense sentences: is the highlighted verb background (imperfective) or a plot event (perfective)?
